title: Calibrating the Effective Track Width From a Run: Spinning in Place Both Ways to Cancel the Gyro's Bias, and How Many Spins Are Enough

artifact.note: the effective track width from turns in place (the wheel travel difference over the heading change measured by a gyro, from runs in both directions so that the gyro's bias cancels), the distance scale from a measured stretch, and the spread of a set of estimates
